name: Improved Cast Rune
body:
You can invoke the power of your chosen runes more often.

Prerequisite(s): Cast Rune.

Benefit: Choose one rune you selected with the Cast Rune feat. You can now invoke this rune’s power three times per day.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to another of your selected runes.
